article.title: Miscellaneous proceedings.
article.content:
141Miscellaneous proceedings.

Section 141
The procedure provided in this Code in regard to suits shall be followed, as far as it can be made applicable, in all proceedings in any Court of civil jurisdiction.
2[Explanation.—In this section, the expression “proceedings” includes proceedings under Order IX, but does not include any proceedings under article 226 of the Constitution.]

2 Ins. by s. 47, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
